messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-08-01] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Review of INC-2025-017 (the auth gateway, 2025-07-27). The root cause was an expired intermediate certificate. We decided that certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2026-05-08] incident-review/INC-2026-009: INC-2026-009 review. What happened: scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. Why: two leaders elected during a network partition. Follow-up decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-02-11] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Review of INC-2025-004 (the notifier, 2025-02-06). The root cause was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. We decided that notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-10-16] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (search-indexer, 2025-10-13). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-04-28] incident-review/INC-2025-011: INC-2025-011 review. What happened: the ledger service saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26. Why: an index missing after the schema migration. Follow-up decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2026-01-22] incident-review/INC-2026-003: Incident review INC-2026-003. Webhooks delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. Root cause: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2025-08-14] standup/boreal/2025-08-14: Changes to auth-gateway need two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2: New dependency for billing-api: feature-flags. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-03-19] standup/ember/2026-03-19: No deploys to the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2025-06-23] standup/atlas/2025-06-23: The quarterly capacity review is run by Priya.
- [2025-02-25] standup/dune/2025-02-25: Reporting can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2026-02-23] standup/dune/2026-02-23: The job scheduler deploy window (unchanged): on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-09-05] handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-08-29: the scheduler went to Atlas, not team Cinder. Team Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-04-18] standup/atlas/2025-04-18: Per the change policy, Ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-12-16] standup/ember/2025-12-16: The ledger service deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-09-15] standup/dune/2025-09-15: We decided that reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly. The reason: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. That removes the dependency on Ledger from reporting.
- [2025-06-13] standup/ember/2025-06-13: Decision: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, because the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.
- [2026-03-10] standup/dune/2026-03-10-2: Observation from team Dune: after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. The webhook dispatcher deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-03-19] standup/ember/2026-03-19-2: Team Ember noticed that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-10-27] standup/dune/2025-10-27-2: New deploy window for scheduler: on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. Forget the previous weekdays after 15:00 UTC slot.
- [2025-01-29] standup/ember/2025-01-29: Per the change policy, auth-gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
